text:
amanda_cs: Quick flag - Quantix (Dedicated eval) token & embed traffic dropped to ~15% yesterday. Renewal ~5w. New procurement lead (Maya) took over last week and they started a short proof-of-concept with AstraMind. Can we triage before QBR? :triage:

henry_se: On it. Do we see errors (5xx/401/429) or customer-side throttles? Any change in request IPs?

ryan_data: Pulled a quick slice. Tokens/hr fell from ~3.8k -> ~570 between 2025-12-01 04:00-05:30 UTC. Error mix: 3% 401, 4% 429, remainder successes. Embeddings disproportionately impacted (~9% of baseline). SQL I ran:

```
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hr, sum(tokens) AS tot
FROM usage.events
WHERE customer = 'quantix'
  AND ts >= now() - interval '10 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 72;
```

ops_bot: [ALERT] customer-quantix: usage-drop-detected. Runbook: cs-triage-usage -> assigned. Incident ID: INC-20251201-QX

henry_se: Doing synthetics to the dedicated host. Also checking firewall/allowlist logs. If their CI rotated egress IPs during procurement handoff we might be dropping some webhook/bulk jobs.

quantix_ops: Confirmed - procurement asked infra to route some jobs through a new NAT to isolate third-party traffic. We rolled the change on 2025-12-01 03:50 UTC. Didn't think it would affect API egress.

henry_se: That matches the window. Our logs show ~4% requests from unknown IPs hitting RBAC/edge rate limiter -> 429s. Embedding pipelines use different client pools so they were hit harder when retry/backoff kicked in.

claire_ae: I talked to Maya this morningshe's worried about cost and is evaluating AstraMind on batch embeds. She paused large daily ETLs. But she also confirmed the NAT change; she didn't expect allowlist work for Redwood.

amanda_cs: So hybrid cause: customer-led pause + infra egress change causing partial rejection. Proposed actions:
- Henry: add temporary IP-range allowlist and relax edge rate limiter for quantix org for 6h (owner @henry_se). ETA 1h.
- Quantix_ops: revert or add mapping for their embed job pool IPs to the legacy NAT while we validate (owner @quantix_ops). ETA 2h.
- Ryan: prepare a concise baseline vs observed chart + per-endpoint breakdown for QBR (owner @ryan_data). ETA 3h.
- Claire: outreach to Maya with a short cost-safety offer + invite to a 30-min demo comparing embed throughput/cost vs AstraMind (owner @claire_ae). ETA today EOD.

quantix_ops: Will roll mapping now and notify when done. Also we'll share the new NAT CIDR.

henry_se: Implemented temporary relax + allowlist for the new NAT CIDR. Monitoring shows 429 rate dropping. Patch note: relaxed org-level token bucket to allow in-flight batch retries while we stabilize.

ops_bot: [RECOVERY] INC-20251201-QX: after allowlist and mapping, traffic recovered to ~88% of baseline within 45m. Incident auto-resolved.

ryan_data: Uploaded slice to /shared/quantix/reports/2025-12-01-drop.csv and chart: https://dash.redwood.internal/nb/quantix/usage

claire_ae: Maya asked for the cost-safety pack: 2-week discounted burst for batch embeds + a one-off cost-breakdown showing savings vs AstraMind. I'll draft outreach and include recommended chunking settings.

amanda_cs: Nice. Follow-ups: Henry verify no further 429s for 24h, Quantix_ops confirm permanent NAT mapping plan, Ryan finalize QBR slide, Claire schedule QBR with Maya. If we don't hit >80% in 24h escalate to renewal-engage. :thumbsup:
